title: 第一章 身死第二章 未知的世界
lines: 皓月当空，朦胧的月光洒在林中小径，虽然稍稍驱散了黑暗，但却泛起冷冽的光芒。幽径凄神寒骨，林间悄怆幽邃。一抹黑影缓缓前行于林中，似与黑暗融为一体，仿若鬼魅。
一栋别墅坐落于林外，高大的围墙环绕四周昭示了院内主人不凡的身份，铁门紧锁，将宅院与外界隔绝。
借着微弱的月光，黑色的身影模糊的浮现出来。一个高大挺拔，身着黑色风衣的青年立于门前，腰间悬着把暗红色刀柄的太刀。
青年抽出了一把匕首撬开了门锁。轻轻推开大门，看着不远处的别墅正门，并没有贸然行动，静静的观察。
十几秒后，青年弯下腰身，将匕首轻轻插进前方的地面。一声金铁相交的清脆声响起，将土缓缓拨开后，一颗地雷暴露在空气中。
青年将地雷缓缓取出后，又将匕首插在了地雷的洞中，轻轻的搅拌着。又是一声脆响，地雷的下方竟然还有一颗地雷！显然院内的主人不是等闲之辈，竟然懂得使用子母雷迷惑敌人，一旦对方大意，后果不堪设想。
第二颗地雷取出，青年继续重复着相同的动作。确定脚下地面已经安全，跨越了一小步，继续仔细的排除地雷。
别墅深处，昏黄的灯光映在宽广的大厅中，一位四十岁左右的中年人坐在沙发上，嘴里叼着一根美国雪茄，将面前的红酒倒在杯中，自饮自酌。
中年人的身后站立着数十位男子，均沉默不语。其中一位从人群中走了出来，站在了中年人的身边，轻声说道：“老板，不派人出去守着真的没问题么，‘魅’组织他们。。。”
听到“魅”组织三个字，中年人夹着雪茄的手微微一颤，不过他显然经历过不少风雨，很快将情绪稳住，呼出浓浓的烟气，道：“没事，屋外都是地雷，你们去了也没有太大用处。虽然我不认为会让对方知难而退，但，我也不认为对方能杀掉咱们这么多人。”
中年人的语气平缓，透露出淡淡的自信，仿佛并不将此事放在心上，但左手的中指却不停的在沙发上敲点，显然内心也是十分忐忑不安。
“明天护照便准备妥当，只要度过今晚，一切就都结束了。”中年人又补充道，虽然像是回答，但更多的是在自言自语，想要压下内心的不安。双眼盯着墙上缓缓摆动的挂钟，内心已经心急如焚，但仍然故作平静。
“吱”的一声轻响，在寂静的大厅中格外刺耳，泛起微微回音。数十位男子齐齐望向门口，一个黑衣男子映入视线之内。虽然被众人注视，男子依然保持着云淡风轻的神态，好似周围的一切与他毫不相关。
“你是‘魅’组织中的哪位？”中年男子依旧坐在沙发上品着红酒，轻声询问。不过心中的幻想早已破碎，升起了破釜沉舟的念头。
“幽夜。”青年淡淡回答了两个字，语气如机械一般不带有一丝情感。
拿着酒杯的手抖了一下，杯中的红酒险些溢出，中年人缓缓将酒杯放下，靠在了沙发上，闭上了双眼，嘴角泛起一抹苦笑。
这厅中的人都是杀手，而且都是略有名气的杀手，自然清楚“魅”组织是何物。一个隐藏于黑暗中的神秘杀手组织，一个不属于任何势力的杀手集团，一个与各国政府隐藏部门都有交集的势力，一群不为报酬，只为杀戮而存在的怪物。黑道势力，各国政府，“魅”组织隐隐为世界三大势力。其中的核心成员都是手刃了上千人的杀戮机器。而幽夜，则是“魅”组织中的王者，是整个杀手界的神话。
听到对方的名号，周围的几十人也都倒吸了口凉气，气氛突然沉重无比，厅中一片寂静，寂静到此时一根银针掉落在地亦能清晰可闻。
幽夜那沉稳的气势给予了这几十位成名杀手如山一般沉重的压力，几分钟后，离幽夜较近的一个杀手终于受不了这种心灵上的压迫，掏出了手枪朝着幽夜一枪射出。
“嘣”，没有预想中幽夜身首异处的场景，或者说这种预想就是纯粹的幻想罢了。在开枪的瞬间，幽夜欺身向前，兔起鹘落，又如黑豹扑食，身法诡异无比，连调整准星的反应时间都没有，眼前一花，幽夜的手则已经捏在了自己的手腕上。
“咔”，毫无意外，腕骨已经被完全捏碎。突如其来的剧痛从手臂上传来，刺得大脑发麻。不过此时开枪之人对于幽夜的恐惧已经胜过了痛觉，口中喃喃自语：“这就，这就是鬼。。。”
话未说完，胸口再次传来剧痛，幽夜右手的三根手指已经插在了自己的左胸。看起来并不算是孔武有力的手指，竟然如同钢筋一般轻松的刺穿了自己的皮肤，插进自己的脏腑之中。
看着面前缓缓倒下的身影，瞪得如铜铃般的眼睛透露出恐惧不甘的神色，幽夜依旧面若冷霜，手指上的鲜血滴在地上，哒哒的响声在静室中透入每个人的耳中，提醒着人们这并非梦境，而是现实。
“咕噜“，其中几人咽下了口唾液，紧张的看着面前平静的幽夜，用眼神与他人交流了一番。
在场的杀手当即会意，各自拿出了趁手的武器。在此时近身状态下与幽夜这种级别的杀手战斗，枪支已经变得无用，况且己方人多，枪械更容易误杀。
被团团围住，幽夜并没有丝毫退意，看着眼前数十位不弱的杀手，缓缓抽出太刀，与众人对峙。
“铛”，兵器相交的脆声响起，回荡在厅中，将这场战斗拉开序幕。
中年人依旧闭着双目靠在沙发上，耳中充斥着兵器相交的声音，惨叫声，倒地声。没有在意惨烈的战斗，幽夜出动，自己已无生还可能。
不到五分钟，周围又恢复了死一般的寂静，中年人睁开眼眸，一道黑色的身影坐在对面，正是幽夜。
幽夜此时连呼吸都没有一丝紊乱，身上的风衣并没有染上血迹，甚至连褶皱都没有。而不远处，所有的杀手都倒在地上，甚至还有着断臂残肢，血液散在地面上，绽放出一簇簇红色的鲜艳的花朵。
“拉菲么？”没有在意中年人吃惊的目光，幽夜拿起了酒杯抿了一口，轻声道。
中年人终于看到了幽夜的脸。五官清秀，刀削般的脸颊透出一股坚毅，明亮的眼瞳灿烂如星辰，嘴角微微上钩露出一抹微笑，如同一个人畜无害的大好青年，根本无法与其和刚才冷漠的杀手联系在一起。
content_en:
The bright moon was in the sky, and the hazy moonlight shone on the forest path. Although it slightly dispelled the darkness, it gave off a cold light. The secluded path is desolate and cold to the soul, and the forest is quiet and melancholy. A black shadow slowly moved forward in the forest, seeming to merge with the darkness, like a ghost.
A villa is located outside the forest. Tall walls surround it, indicating the extraordinary identity of the owner. The iron gate is locked, isolating the house from the outside world.
Through the faint moonlight, a black figure appeared vaguely. A tall and erect young man wearing a black windbreaker stood in front of the door, with a dark red handle hanging from his waist.
The young man pulled out a dagger and pried open the door lock. He gently pushed the door open and looked at the main entrance of the villa not far away. He did not act rashly and observed quietly.
Ten seconds later, the young man bent down and gently inserted the dagger into the ground in front of him. There was a crisp sound of gold and iron intersecting, and after the soil was slowly pushed away, a landmine was exposed in the air.
After the young man slowly took out the mine, he inserted the dagger into the hole of the mine and stirred it gently. There was another crisp sound, and there was a landmine underneath the mine! Obviously, the owner of the courtyard is no ordinary person. He actually knows how to use Zimu Lei to confuse the enemy. Once the opponent is careless, the consequences will be disastrous.
The second mine was taken out, and the young man continued to repeat the same action. After confirming that the ground under his feet was safe, he took a small step and continued to carefully eliminate landmines.
Deep in the villa, dim lights reflected in the vast hall, a middle-aged man in his forties was sitting on the sofa, holding an American cigar in his mouth, pouring the red wine in front of him into a glass, and drinking to himself.
Dozens of men stood behind the middle-aged man, all of them silent. One of them walked out of the crowd, stood beside the middle-aged man, and said softly: "Boss, is it really okay if you don't send people out to guard them? Charming will organize them..."
Hearing the word "Charming" organization, the middle-aged man's hand holding the cigar trembled slightly. However, he had obviously experienced a lot of hardships. He quickly calmed down and exhaled thick smoke. He said: "It's okay. There are landmines outside the house. It won't be of much use if you go there. Although I don't think the other party will retreat in the face of difficulties, but I don't think the other party can kill so many of us."
The middle-aged man's tone was calm, revealing a touch of confidence, as if he didn't take the matter to heart, but the middle finger of his left hand kept tapping on the sofa, obviously feeling very uneasy inside.
"The passport will be ready tomorrow. As long as we spend tonight, everything will be over." The middle-aged man added, although it seemed like an answer, he was more talking to himself, trying to suppress his inner uneasiness. He stared at the slowly swinging clock on the wall, feeling anxious inside but still pretending to be calm.
A soft "squeak" sound was particularly harsh in the silent hall, and there was a slight echo. Dozens of men looked at the door, and a man in black came into view. Although everyone was watching, the man still maintained a calm demeanor, as if everything around him had nothing to do with him.
"Who are you in the Charming organization?" the middle-aged man asked softly, still sitting on the sofa and sipping red wine. However, the fantasy in my heart has long been shattered, and the thought of burning the boat has arisen.
"Youye." The young man replied with two words, his tone was robotic and without a trace of emotion.
The hand holding the wine glass shook, and the red wine in the glass almost overflowed. The middle-aged man slowly put the wine glass down, leaned on the sofa, closed his eyes, and a wry smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
The people in this hall are all killers, and they are all slightly famous killers. Naturally, they know what the "Charming" organization is. A mysterious killer organization hidden in the darkness, a killer group that does not belong to any force, a force that intersects with hidden departments of governments of various countries, a group of monsters that do not seek reward, but only exist for killing. The underworld forces, governments of various countries, and the "Charming" organization are vaguely the three major forces in the world. The core members are all killing machines who have killed thousands of people. And You Ye is the king of the "Charming" organization and the myth of the entire killer world.
Hearing the other party's name, dozens of people around him took a deep breath. The atmosphere suddenly became heavy, and the hall was so silent that one could clearly hear a silver needle falling to the ground.
You Ye's calm aura put a mountain of pressure on these dozens of famous killers. After a few minutes, a killer who was closer to You Ye finally couldn't stand the psychological oppression anymore and took out his pistol and shot You Ye.
"Bang", there was no expected scene of You Ye's body being dislocated, or this expectation was just a pure fantasy. At the moment of shooting, You Ye leaned forward, like a rabbit rising and a falcon falling, like a panther pouncing on food. His movements were so weird that he didn't even have time to adjust the sight. His eyes blurred, and You Ye's hand was already pinched on his wrist.
"Click", no surprise, the wrist bone has been completely crushed. A sudden sharp pain shot up from his arm, stinging his brain. But at this time, the person who shot the gun was more afraid of Youye than the pain, and murmured to himself: "This is, this is a ghost..."
Before he finished speaking, sharp pain came from his chest again, and three fingers of Youye's right hand were inserted into his left chest. The fingers, which did not appear to be powerful, actually pierced his skin and inserted into his organs as easily as steel bars.
Looking at the slowly falling figure in front of him, his eyes as wide as bells showed a look of fear and unwillingness. You Ye still had a frosty face, and the blood on his fingers dripped on the ground. The clicking sound penetrated into everyone's ears in the quiet room, reminding people that this was not a dream, but reality.
"Gulu", several of them swallowed their saliva, looked nervously at the calm You Ye in front of them, and communicated with others with their eyes.
The killers present immediately understood and each took out their own weapons. At this time, when fighting a killer of You Ye's level at close range, guns have become useless. Moreover, there are many people on one's side, and guns are more likely to kill by mistake.
Surrounded by everyone, You Ye had no intention of retreating. Looking at the dozens of powerful killers in front of him, he slowly drew out his sword and faced off with everyone.
"Cang", the crisp sound of weapons clashing echoed in the hall, kicking off the battle.
The middle-aged man was still leaning on the sofa with his eyes closed, and his ears were filled with the sound of weapons clashing, screams, and the sound of falling to the ground. Not paying attention to the fierce battle, You Ye went out, but there was no chance of his own survival.
In less than five minutes, the surroundings returned to deathly silence. The middle-aged man opened his eyes and saw a black figure sitting opposite, it was You Ye.
You Ye's breathing was not disturbed at this time, and the windbreaker on his body was not stained with blood or even wrinkled. Not far away, all the killers fell to the ground, even with broken arms and limbs. Blood was scattered on the ground, and clusters of bright red flowers bloomed.
"Lafite?" Not paying attention to the middle-aged man's surprised gaze, You Ye picked up the wine glass and took a sip, saying softly.
The middle-aged man finally saw You Ye's face. His facial features are delicate, his knife-like cheeks reveal a sense of perseverance, his bright eyes are as bright as stars, and the corner of his mouth is slightly curved into a smile. He is like a good young man who is harmless to humans and animals. There is no way he can be associated with the indifferent killer just now.
title_en: Chapter 1 Death Chapter 2 The Unknown World
